| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Regions | Regions, Filtered image, Boundaries over the image, Mean color of each region | The regions as a label map, drawn over the image and listed in the Features panel. Or the mean-shift filtered image, which is flat inside each region. Or the boundaries in yellow over the image, or each region filled with its mean color. |
| **Spatial radius** `spatialRadius` | 10 | 1 to 50 px | How far in position the window reaches. |
| **Color radius** `colorRadius` | 20 | 1 to 100 levels | How far in color the window reaches. |
| **Pyramid levels** `levels` | 1 | 0 to 3 | OpenCV runs on a pyramid with this many smaller levels, and refines from the smallest. OpenCV uses 1. |
| **Color tolerance** `colorTolerance` | 2 | 0 to 20 levels | Neighbors whose filtered colors differ by at most this in each channel join one region. 0 joins equal colors only. |
